mechanism.claim: A simultaneous own-history average-ticket shock across at least four liquid alt perpetuals, accompanied by one common completed five-minute return direction, identifies broad large-order sponsorship rather than an isolated price print or merely more executions. During elevated BTC variation, follow the sponsored direction in BTC for eight hours.
mechanism.side: common strict return sign among at least four large-ticket-shocked alts
mechanism.why_distinct: HVCACJP thresholds return magnitude and HVCABBD thresholds price-region discovery. HVCAVSC thresholds total quote turnover, while CATLR compares block-level BTC-versus-alt ticket leadership. HVCALTS instead thresholds each alt's current five-minute average quote notional per execution against its own strictly prior 30-day distribution, then uses return sign only for direction; it uses no BTC return direction, flow imbalance, value anchor, funding, OI, premium, fitted outcome, reused event set, or promoted control.
mechanism.why_suited_to_volatile_regimes: causal trailing BTC twenty-four-hour realized variation must occupy its upper 35 percent
mechanism.why_low_gross9_overlap_is_plausible: irregular simultaneous cross-alt own-history large-ticket shocks are absent from Gross9 primitives

features.decision_grid: every exact UTC five-minute boundary D
features.five_minute_bar: five exact coherent native one-minute bars [D-5m,D) per symbol
features.alt_return: log(last completed close/first completed open), finite strict nonzero for a directional shocked alt
features.alt_average_ticket: sum quote_asset_volume / sum number_of_trades over the completed five-minute bar, finite strict positive denominator and result
features.ticket_history: 8640 strictly prior source-valid five-minute observations per alt (30 days), current excluded; minimum 6048
features.ticket_threshold: numpy-linear strict-prior 0.95 quantile independently per alt
features.directional_consensus: at least four shocked alts have one common strict return sign and strictly outnumber opposite shocked signs
features.btc_realized_variation: sqrt(sum squared exact BTC one-minute log(close/open) returns over [D-24h,D)), finite strict positive
features.variation_history: at most 8640 strictly prior source-valid decisions, minimum 6048, current excluded
features.onset: full broad large-ticket-shock direction exists now and did not exist at immediately prior exact source-valid five-minute decision; missing prior cannot trigger

clock.decision: D immediately after all seven completed five-minute bars are available
clock.reservation: global chronological half-open; exit first on equal open
clock.funding: not signal input; exact settlements only after novelty

economic_gates.accounting: fixed quantity, exact funding, 6bp/10bp per notional side, every held 5m favorable then adverse, global HWM, full-calendar CAGR

source_plan.execution_prices: sealed until source and novelty pass

research_boundary.selection_basis: independent irregular cross-sectional large-order-unit sponsorship confirmation

stopping_rule: terminal first failure; no universe, bar, average-ticket definition, history, quantile, breadth, variation, onset, side, clock, hold, subset, threshold, comparator, or control repair
